what_this_is: WRITTEN PERMISSION TO ADAPT A SUPPLIER'S PHOTOGRAPH INTO A PLOTNUA COMPOSITE (H2, 20 Oct 2026). A different thing from image-rights-records.json, which records HOST grants for hot-linked, unmodified supplier imagery and doubles as the supplier listing record. A licence here: (1) enumerates each source photograph by SHA-256; (2) binds each to exactly one composite (bound_composite); (3) says whether modification is permitted; (4) names the credit that must sit beside the composite. It authorises no hot-linking, no re-hosting of the photograph itself, and no listing.
governance: Atlas is the source of record: record the permission in Image Permission Outreach first, then here with its outreach ref and a non-sensitive evidence_ref. THIS FILE IS PUBLIC: it carries only what is needed to establish and validate the permission. Correspondence identifiers, contact addresses and quoted correspondence stay private in Atlas, where the evidence_ref resolves to them (Image Permission Outreach notes). permission_outcome uses the rights gate's own vocabulary; a withdrawal (a changed outcome or a withdrawal_effective_at) breaks the binding in the provenance guard at once (P6, P10, P13). atlas-tools/prove-timberin-containment.mjs (T5) refuses this file if it carries a contact address, a correspondence identifier, an Atlas internal id or quoted correspondence.
read_by: atlas-tools/validate-image-provenance.js (the licensed-photography exception to P6 and P10; P13)
not_read_by: atlas-tools/publication-gate.mjs and the Results / wellness / Additional Home generators
